info.title: v2.logistics.get_tracking_info
info.description: Use this api to get the logistics tracking information of an order.

get.description: Use this api to get the logistics tracking information of an order.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: order_sn
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for an order.

parameters.name: package_number
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for the package under an order. You shouldn't fill the field with empty string when there is a package number.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/get_tracking_info?access_token=access_token&order_sn=201214JASXYXY6&package_number=9000192023232&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: return_code
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The OTP generated after the parcel enters the RTS (Return to Seller) process. Sellers need to provide this OTP to the driver to complete the return confirmation. Note: - This field only applies to orders under the SPX Instant & Sameday channel in ID region. - This field is only returned when the driver has initiated the return process to the seller. If the driver has not initiated the return process for the parcel, this field will be empty.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: collection_pin_code
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: [TW Only] The unique 6-digit PIN code for sellers to collect RTS (Return to Seller) parcels at service points. This field is returned when the channel is C2C and the logistics_status is FULFILMENT_DELIVERY_FAILED.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: reversed_tracking_number
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The tracking number of the reversed logistics. Note: Only apply to the cross-border segment of failed delivery parcels returned from the local return warehouse to the seller.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: reversed_courier_name
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The courier name of the reversed logistics. Note: Only apply to the cross-border segment of failed delivery parcels returned from the local return warehouse to the seller.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: reversed_tracking_info
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The tracking information of the reversed logistics. Note: Only apply to the cross-border segment of failed delivery parcels returned from the local return warehouse to the seller.
